text: Three real findings -- now it's time to decide exactly what this project builds, and what it deliberately doesn't.
In scope: tuned Sentinel and Defender XDR detection, Azure and AWS identity visibility, a Conditional Access zero-trust pilot, and Python-based security automation.
The pilot starts narrow on purpose: CA-RequireMFA-AllUsers tenant-wide, with one named, tracked exclusion group for legacy service accounts.
Out of scope: a full enterprise zero-trust rollout, redesigning the core banking integration, and building a brand-new SOAR platform.
Next: turning 'better detection' into real, measurable targets.
